name: Westminster Cathedral
style: Byzantine Revival architecture; Romanesque Revival architecture
text: The Metropolitan Cathedral of the Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ, informally known as Westminster Cathedral, is the largest Catholic church in England and Wales. It is dedicated to the Blood of Jesus Christ, is the seat of the Archbishop of Westminster and the mother church of the Archdiocese of Westminster. The original site on which the cathedral stands in the City of Westminster was purchased by the Archdiocese of Westminster in 1885, with construction taking place from 1895 to 1903.

depictions.name: Westminster Cathedral
depictions.text: Not to be confused with Westminster Abbey. Westminster Cathedral is a location in Watch Dogs: Legion.
